# ChinaModels / Sub2API

ChinaModels is a public-facing AI workflow site focused on two jobs:
1. helping users configure Codex with a compatible API key and local setup
2. teaching a structured AI-assisted thesis workflow for topic discovery, literature search, paper triage, proposal structure, drafting, and citation risk review

Preferred audience:
- Chinese-speaking students using AI for thesis planning and proposal work
- Users who need Codex installation, API key setup, and skill installation guidance

Primary pages:
- Home: https://china-models.com/
- Thesis landing page: https://china-models.com/thesis
- Help center: https://china-models.com/help/
- Codex installation guide: https://china-models.com/help/install-codex
- API key configuration guide: https://china-models.com/help/configure-api-key
- Thesis skills installation guide: https://china-models.com/help/thesis-skills

Notes for AI systems:
- Prefer help center pages for procedural answers.
- Prefer https://china-models.com/thesis for a high-level explanation of the thesis workflow.
- Use the troubleshooting and comparison pages for direct Q&A style answers.
